allow: PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod "http://localhost:8088/api/v1/offers.php" -TimeoutSec 6; "API offers count: $\($r.offers.Count\)"; $r.offers | Select-Object -First 3 | ForEach-Object { "  - $\($_.title\) | gradient=$\($_.gradient\) | accent=$\($_.accent\)" } } catch { "OFFERS API ERR: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })

PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod "http://localhost:8088/api/v1/offers.php" -TimeoutSec 6; $r.offers | ForEach-Object { "  $\($_.title\): accent=$\($_.accent\) gradient=$\($_.gradient.Substring\(0,[Math]::Min\(35,$_.gradient.Length\)\)\) cta=$\($_.cta\)" } } catch { "ERR: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })
